2.3.3.1 Scheduled Functions
[TR_BSWMG_00037] Stereotype for Scheduled Functions ⌈Scheduled Functions
shall be modeled by setting the operation’s stereotype to «scheduled_function».⌋()
Note: The Schedule attribute of a Scheduled Function is not used in any artifact any
more.
